title: THE CITADEL
message: You can see where you want to be. That doesn't mean you know the way there.
meaning: The Citadel represents a destination that is visible but structurally unreachable from the current path. Its appearance suggests that another route exists — even if Houdini does not show it yet.
imageAlt: Official card artwork for The Citadel
mechanic: Hidden-path ARCANE card. It requires THE LOCK and HIDDEN_PATH, then unlocks the CITADEL_ROUTE node.
